modern: He who has seen present things has seen all, both everything which has taken place from all eternity and everything which will be for time without end; for all things are of one kin and of one form.

explained.summary: If you’ve really seen what is happening now, you’ve seen everything that ever happened and everything that ever will. All things are of one kind and follow the same patterns. History may change its costumes, but human life and nature play out in much the same way.
